leads.head: Zelensky: Ukraine sank a Russian warship off Libya
leads.sub: Kyiv says sea drones sank the corvette Merkury at Benghazi and hit the cargo ship Angara. The Kremlin warns of "escalation"; Albania denies the drones came from its soil.

leads.head: Nvidia brings back Huang; Wall St surges
leads.sub: Trump says he "convinced" the board, 11 days after Huang quit over an alleged Chinese spy affair; Democrats vow a probe. Nvidia adds almost $1tn in value and the Nasdaq jumps 6.5%.

leads.head: National strike grounds all Belgian flights
leads.sub: Air traffic halts 06:00-20:00 GMT and trains are cancelled as unions march in Brussels against EUR 10bn of budget cuts.
